# Microsoft Account

> Microsoft Account is the central hub for managing Microsoft 365 subscriptions, family safety features, and cross-device digital wellness across Windows, Xbox, and mobile platforms.

This site provides users with tools to manage their Microsoft accounts, configure family safety and parental controls, monitor screen time, and control content access across multiple devices and platforms including Windows, Xbox, Android, and iOS.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Family Safety
- Microsoft 365
- Parental Controls
- Screen Time Limits
- Digital Wellness
- Content Filtering
- Web Filtering
- Device Management
- Family Features
- Windows 10
- Windows 11
- Xbox
- Microsoft Edge

## Family Safety & Parental Controls

- [Microsoft Family Safety | Microsoft 365](https://account.microsoft.com/family/about): Microsoft Family Safety product overview with parental controls and digital wellness features
